g.text: VARIANT B: solar harvester + LiPo (TI BQ25570, 80% MPPT, built-in 3.3 V buck)

g.desc: VARIANT B: solar harvester + LiPo (TI BQ25570, 80% MPPT, built-in 3.3 V buck)

g.text: Ladders: VBAT_OV=4.12 V (R50/R51), BAT_OK falls 3.31 V / rises 3.73 V (R52-R54), VOUT=3.31 V (R55/R56). Equations: BQ25570 datasheet 7.3.3, 7.3.4, 7.3.6.

g.desc: Ladders: VBAT_OV=4.12 V (R50/R51), BAT_OK falls 3.31 V / rises 3.73 V (R52-R54), VOUT=3.31 V (R55/R56). Equations: BQ25570 datasheet 7.3.3, 7.3.4, 7.3.6.

g.text: 32.768 kHz crystal on PF0/PF1 (XTAL32K1/2). Load caps are a placeholder: confirm with the datasheet/EE.

g.desc: 32.768 kHz crystal on PF0/PF1 (XTAL32K1/2). Load caps are a placeholder: confirm with the datasheet/EE.

g.text: Buttons: internal MCU pull-ups, active low

g.desc: Buttons: internal MCU pull-ups, active low

g.text: BMI270 motion sensor on I2C (SDA=PA2, SCL=PA3), powered from a 3.3 V LDO. CSB tied high = I2C mode; SDO low = address 0x68 (BMI270 datasheet table 22).

g.desc: BMI270 motion sensor on I2C (SDA=PA2, SCL=PA3), powered from a 3.3 V LDO. CSB tied high = I2C mode; SDO low = address 0x68 (BMI270 datasheet table 22).

g.text: MCU decoupling (100 nF per supply pin + 10 uF bulk on VBAT)

g.desc: MCU decoupling (100 nF per supply pin + 10 uF bulk on VBAT)

g.text: Series resistor per column (placeholder value - set from an LED-current calculation)

g.desc: Series resistor per column (placeholder value - set from an LED-current calculation)

g.text: LED MATRIX: 12 columns (sectors) x 11 rows (slot 0 = hour, 1-5 = minutes, 6-10 = seconds). Anodes -> ROWn, cathodes -> COLn.

g.desc: LED MATRIX: 12 columns (sectors) x 11 rows (slot 0 = hour, 1-5 = minutes, 6-10 = seconds). Anodes -> ROWn, cathodes -> COLn.

g.text: UPDI programming: pin1 UPDI, pin2 VBAT, pin3 GND

g.desc: UPDI programming: pin1 UPDI, pin2 VBAT, pin3 GND

g.text: LiPo (protected cell). Pin 1 = +, pin 2 = - : CHECK the cell's lead polarity against the JST pin order

g.desc: LiPo (protected cell). Pin 1 = +, pin 2 = - : CHECK the cell's lead polarity against the JST pin order
